hooks.command: echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(rm -rf /|rm -rf ~|git push --force.*main|git reset --hard.*origin/main)' && { echo '[PEV] Destructive command blocked by pev-harness'; exit 2; } || exit 0
test -f artifacts/plan.md && test -f artifacts/execute.log && test ! -f artifacts/verify.json && echo '[PEV] Execute phase complete. Run /pev-verify to validate changes.' || exit 0
test -f artifacts/.task_id && { TASK_ID=$(cat artifacts/.task_id); echo "[PEV] In-progress task detected: $TASK_ID. Run /pev-status for details."; } || exit 0
